body.text: Four days after the Bend school attack, the legal questions are turning to how the shotgun was obtained, not to the parent who stopped the attacker.

The man who followed the attacker into Silver Rail Elementary has been identified by his family as the father of two students; prosecutors declined to confirm details and say any charges depend on the evidence. Recommendation: resume evergreen content this week, keep Bend out of all marketing, and hold any general 'after a defensive shooting' explainer until at least Wednesday.
